rules.name: Hypertensive Crisis
rules.condition: Hypertensive Crisis — Immediate Emergency Care Required
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required. Contact 108 Emergency Ambulance service or transfer to CHC/District Hospital.

rules.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome Presentation
rules.criteria: (chest pain OR chest discomfort OR cardiac pain) AND (shortness of breath OR breathlessness OR dizziness OR palpitations OR sweating OR radiating pain)
rules.finding: Acute Coronary Syndrome Presentation (Chest pain combined with acute distress / breathlessness)
rules.condition: Suspected Acute Myocardial Infarction / Unstable Angina — Call 108 Immediately
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required. Contact 108 Emergency Ambulance service.

rules.name: Unexplained Acute Chest Pain
rules.condition: Acute Chest Pain Evaluation Required — Emergency Referral
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Acute Pulmonary Hemoptysis
rules.criteria: coughing blood OR blood in sputum OR hemoptysis OR vomiting blood
rules.finding: Acute Hemoptysis / Bleeding (Coughing blood or blood in sputum)
rules.condition: Acute Hemoptysis / Severe Pulmonary Hemorrhage — Urgent Hospital Triage
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Severe Hyperpyrexia
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Critical Hyperglycemic Emergency
rules.finding: Critical Hyperglycemia ({glucose_mg_dl} mg/dL >= 400 mg/dL — DKA / HHS Risk)
rules.condition: Critical Diabetic Hyperglycemic Crisis — Immediate IV Hydration & PHC/CHC Transfer
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Severe Neuroglycopenic Hypoglycemia
rules.condition: Severe Acute Hypoglycemia — Administer Fast-Acting Glucose / Urgent Care
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Severe Tachyarrhythmia
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Severe Symptomatic Bradycardia
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Critical Hypotension / Shock State
rules.finding: Critical Hypotension / Shock State (Systolic BP: {systolic_bp} mmHg < 80 mmHg)
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.

rules.name: Altered Mental Status / Acute Deficit
rules.criteria: unconscious OR loss of consciousness OR fainting with seizure OR altered mental status OR slurred speech
rules.condition: Acute Neurological Emergency / Stroke / Encephalopathy Alert
rules.action: 🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAG: Immediate medical intervention required.
